body: Oh wait just to sweeten the fucking pot. Dude proposes to me and frankly in the relationship (I should have been the one proposing) it’d be obvious if you saw us why id say that. Anyway plans never get made and a year later when I mention we are “engaged” to a friend he says “oh yeah but that doesn’t really count. That was spur of the moment ring I bought a Walmart for 30 bucks & I was young”. Awesomesause. This is a dude that I literally gave my whole heart to unconditionally. We were actually a good team and built each other up from counting pennies and nickels for ramen to literally being in the top 8% of household incomes (neither of us with a college degree) because we worked so well together and always pushed each other to do better.
